description: The figure group is a single rendered table (no panels, no axes, no scale bars), presented as Table III with the caption "Room-temperature tensile properties of cold-rolled Fe-7Al alloy produced by AIMFC". The table has a bold header row separated from the data row by a thin horizontal rule, with four columns: "Properties", "UTS (MPa)", "YS (MPa)" and "EL total (%)". The single data row is labelled "Fe-7Al alloy (cold rolled and annealed)" — printed on three lines in the leftmost cell — and reports UTS = 467 ± 5.8 MPa, YS = 340 ± 8.1 MPa and EL total = 40 ± 3.5. Each value carries a plus-minus scatter band, indicating mean ± standard deviation of the room-temperature tensile test. No other composition (e.g. 9 wt.% Al), no processing variant, no temperature and no specimen orientation is tabulated; the alloy designation is given as Fe-7Al (7 wt.% Al, stated in the paper abstract) and the condition as cold rolled and annealed. The table demonstrates that the AIMFC-processed Fe-7Al alloy in the cold-rolled-and-annealed condition reaches roughly 467 MPa ultimate tensile strength, 340 MPa yield strength and about 40% total elongation at room temperature, i.e. a combination of moderate strength with high ductility after a single reported thermo-mechanical condition.

subfigures.description: One header row and one data row. Columns: Properties, UTS (MPa), YS (MPa), EL total (%). Data row: 'Fe-7Al alloy (cold rolled and annealed)' with 467 ± 5.8, 340 ± 8.1 and 40 ± 3.5. A thin horizontal rule separates the bold header from the data row.

observations.observation: The image is a table with the bold column headers 'Properties', 'UTS (MPa)', 'YS (MPa)' and 'EL total (%)', separated from the data row by a horizontal rule.
The table contains exactly one data row, whose row label is printed as 'Fe-7Al alloy (cold rolled and annealed)'.
The tabulated UTS value is 467 ± 5.8 MPa.
The tabulated YS value is 340 ± 8.1 MPa.
The tabulated total elongation is 40 ± 3.5 %, column header 'EL total (%)'.
Every reported property carries a plus-minus uncertainty, indicating mean ± scatter rather than a single measurement.
No temperature, strain rate, specimen orientation, gauge length or test standard is printed inside the table itself.
The caption states the table is 'Table III. Room-temperature tensile properties of cold-rolled Fe-7Al alloy produced by AIMFC'.
The caption attributes the alloy route to AIMFC, a processing method that is not named or expanded anywhere inside the table image.
The caption specifies room temperature as the tensile test condition, which the table image itself does not display.
The row label combines the alloy identity (Fe-7Al) and the condition (cold rolled and annealed), so the reported values apply to that single condition only.
The table reports no value for any 9 wt.% Al alloy or any other Fe-Al composition, so it cannot support composition comparisons on its own.
